/* ---------------- fonts ---------------- */
function useFonts() {
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = "portfolio-fonts";
    if (document.getElementById(id)) return;
    const link = document.createElement("link");
    link.id = id;
    link.rel = "stylesheet";
    link.href =
      "https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Baloo+2:wght@500;600;700;800&family=Nunito:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap";
    document.head.appendChild(link);
  }, []);
}

function getTechLogo(tech) {
  const t = tech.toLowerCase();
  const order = ["scikitlearn","tensorflow","javascript","playwright","bootstrap","streamlit","fastapi","pytorch","sqlite","django","github","python","opencv","pandas","numpy","mysql","azure","html5","css3","java","git","c"];
  for (const key of order) {
    if (t.includes(key) || (key === "c" && /\bc\b/.test(t))) return LOGO_MAP[key];
  }
  return null;
}

/* ---------------- roaming pet (white bunny-cat, walks on its own) ---------------- */
function useWalkStyles() {
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = "pet-walk-styles";
    if (document.getElementById(id)) return;
    const style = document.createElement("style");
    style.id = id;
    style.textContent = `
      @keyframes petBob { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-3px); } }
      .pet-bob { animation: petBob .32s steps(2) infinite; }

      @keyframes petRun { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0) scaleX(1.04); } 50% { transform: translateY(-6px) scaleX(0.96); } }
      .pet-run { animation: petRun .16s steps(2) infinite; }

      @keyframes tailSwish { 0%,100% { transform: rotate(-10deg); } 50% { transform: rotate(12deg); } }
      .pet-tail-swish { animation: tailSwish .55s ease-in-out infinite; transform-origin: 38px 31px; transform-box: fill-box; }

      @keyframes tailSwishFast { 0%,100% { transform: rotate(-16deg); } 50% { transform: rotate(18deg); } }
      .pet-tail-swish-fast { animation: tailSwishFast .22s ease-in-out infinite; transform-origin: 38px 31px; transform-box: fill-box; }

      @keyframes scratchPaw { 0%,100% { transform: rotate(-8deg); } 50% { transform: rotate(-52deg); } }
      .pet-scratch-paw { animation: scratchPaw .22s ease-in-out infinite; transform-origin: 29px 33px; transform-box: fill-box; }

      @keyframes scratchHead { 0%,100% { transform: rotate(0deg); } 50% { transform: rotate(-4deg); } }
      .pet-scratch-head { animation: scratchHead .22s ease-in-out infinite; transform-origin: 22px 30px; transform-box: fill-box; }

      @keyframes petBreathe { 0%,100% { transform: scaleY(1); } 50% { transform: scaleY(1.045); } }
      .pet-breathe { animation: petBreathe 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; transform-origin: 24px 36px; transform-box: fill-box; }

      @keyframes zFloat { 0% { opacity:0; transform: translate(0,0) scale(.5); } 25% { opacity:1; } 100% { opacity:0; transform: translate(7px,-18px) scale(1.15); } }
      .pet-z1 { animation: zFloat 2s ease-in infinite; }
      .pet-z2 { animation: zFloat 2s ease-in infinite .55s; }
      .pet-z3 { animation: zFloat 2s ease-in infinite 1.1s; }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
  }, []);
}

/* pet behavior states: "walk" | "run" | "sit" | "scratch" | "sleep" */
function RoamingPet() {
  useWalkStyles();
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const pos = useRef({ x: 200, y: 200 });
  const target = useRef({ x: 200, y: 200 });
  const facing = useRef(1);
  const actionRef = useRef("walk");
  const idleTimeout = useRef(null);
  const [action, setAction] = useState("walk");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
    pos.current = { x: window.innerWidth * 0.2, y: 120 };
    target.current = { ...pos.current };

    function setAct(a) {
      actionRef.current = a;
      setAction(a);
    }

    function pickNewSpot() {
      target.current = {
        x: 30 + Math.random() * (window.innerWidth - 60),
        y: 90 + Math.random() * Math.min(window.innerHeight - 220, 420),
      };
    }

    function goWander() {
      pickNewSpot();
      setAct(Math.random() < 0.25 ? "run" : "walk");
    }

    function startIdle() {
      const roll = Math.random();
      const next = roll < 0.4 ? "sleep" : roll < 0.75 ? "scratch" : "sit";
      setAct(next);
      const duration =
        next === "sleep" ? 4500 + Math.random() * 4000 :
        next === "scratch" ? 1600 + Math.random() * 1400 :
        1800 + Math.random() * 1800;
      idleTimeout.current = setTimeout(goWander, duration);
    }

    goWander();

    let raf;
    function animate() {
      const act = actionRef.current;
      if (act === "walk" || act === "run") {
        const dx = target.current.x - pos.current.x;
        const dy = target.current.y - pos.current.y;
        const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        const speed = act === "run" ? 0.075 : 0.035;
        pos.current.x += dx * speed;
        pos.current.y += dy * speed;
        if (Math.abs(dx) > 3) facing.current = dx < 0 ? -1 : 1;
        if (dist < 2) startIdle();
      }
      if (ref.current) {
        ref.current.style.transform = `translate(${pos.current.x - 22}px, ${pos.current.y - 22}px) scaleX(${facing.current})`;
      }
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(animate);

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(idleTimeout.current);
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    };
  }, []);

  const moving = action === "walk" || action === "run";
  const sleeping = action === "sleep";
  const scratching = action === "scratch";
  const bodyClass = action === "run" ? "pet-run" : action === "walk" ? "pet-bob" : sleeping ? "pet-breathe" : "";
  const tailClass = action === "run" ? "pet-tail-swish-fast" : moving ? "pet-tail-swish" : "";

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      className="fixed top-0 left-0 w-11 h-11 pointer-events-none z-50"
      style={{ willChange: "transform" }}
    >
      <div className={bodyClass}>
        <svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" className="w-full h-full" style={{ filter: "drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.55))" }}>
          {/* zzz while sleeping */}
          {sleeping && (
            <>
              <text x="30" y="10" fontSize="7" fill="#ffffff" fontWeight="bold" className="pet-z1">z</text>
              <text x="34" y="6" fontSize="6" fill="#ffffff" fontWeight="bold" className="pet-z2">z</text>
              <text x="37" y="3" fontSize="5" fill="#ffffff" fontWeight="bold" className="pet-z3">z</text>
            </>
          )}
          {/* tail */}
          <ellipse cx="38" cy="33" rx="4.5" ry="3.5" fill="#ffffff" className={tailClass} />
          {/* body - settles low while sleeping */}
          <ellipse cx="24" cy={sleeping ? 35 : 32} rx="14" ry={sleeping ? 8 : 11} fill="#ffffff" />
          {/* paws */}
          {!sleeping && <ellipse cx="16" cy="41" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#ffffff" />}
          {!sleeping && !scratching && <ellipse cx="30" cy="41" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#ffffff" />}
          {/* scratching hind paw */}
          {scratching && (
            <ellipse cx="30" cy="20" rx="3.6" ry="2.8" fill="#ffffff" className="pet-scratch-paw" />
          )}
          {/* head group (tilts slightly while scratching) */}
          <g className={scratching ? "pet-scratch-head" : ""}>
            {/* ears */}
            <path d="M13 14 C 10 4, 17 1, 19 10 C 20 15, 16 17, 13 14 Z" fill="#ffffff" />
            <path d="M31 14 C 34 4, 27 1, 25 10 C 24 15, 28 17, 31 14 Z" fill="#ffffff" />
            <path d="M14.5 12 C 13 6, 16.5 4, 17.5 9.5 C 18 12.5, 16 14, 14.5 12 Z" fill="#ff8fc0" />
            <path d="M29.5 12 C 31 6, 27.5 4, 26.5 9.5 C 26 12.5, 28 14, 29.5 12 Z" fill="#ff8fc0" />
            {/* head */}
            <circle cx="22" cy="19" r="10.5" fill="#ffffff" />
            {/* eyes: closed arcs while sleeping, dots otherwise */}
            {sleeping ? (
              <>
                <path d="M16.5 19 Q18.5 21 20.5 19" stroke="#111116" strokeWidth="1.2" fill="none" strokeLinecap="round" />
                <path d="M23.5 19 Q25.5 21 27.5 19" stroke="#111116" strokeWidth="1.2" fill="none" strokeLinecap="round" />
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <circle cx="18.5" cy="19" r="1.3" fill="#111116" />
                <circle cx="25.5" cy="19" r="1.3" fill="#111116" />
              </>
            )}
            {/* nose */}
            <path d="M21 22 L23 22 L22 23.4 Z" fill="#ff8fc0" />
          </g>
        </svg>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------------- small UI helpers ---------------- */
function TechBadge({ children }) {
  const logo = getTechLogo(String(children));
  if (logo) {
    return (
      <span
        title={children}
        className="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-zinc-800/80 p-2 border border-zinc-700/50 hover:bg-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-500 transition-colors w-10 h-10 group relative cursor-pointer"
      >
        <img src={logo} alt={children} className="w-6 h-6 object-contain flex-shrink-0" />
      </span>
    );
  }
  return (
    <span
      className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold rounded-full border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-800/80 text-zinc-200 px-3.5 py-1.5"
      style={F_DISPLAY}
    >
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}

function Btn({ children, onClick, href, primary, disabled, target }) {
  const cls = `inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium border transition
    ${primary
      ? "text-white border-transparent"
      : "bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-100 border-zinc-800 hover:border-violet-500 hover:-translate-y-0.5"}
    ${disabled ? "opacity-40 pointer-events-none" : ""}`;
  const style = primary ? { background: "linear-gradient(135deg,#9b6bff,#ff5fa8)" } : {};
  if (href) {
    return (
      <a href={href} target={target || "_blank"} rel="noopener noreferrer" className={cls} style={style}>
        {children}
      </a>
    );
  }
  return (
    <button onClick={onClick} className={cls} style={style}>
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

      <div className="flex items-start gap-4 sm:gap-5 pr-8">
        <div
          className={`w-16 h-16 sm:w-20 sm:h-20 rounded-2xl flex-shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden ${

        >
          {e.logo ? (
            <img src={e.logo} alt={e.company} className="w-full h-full object-contain" />

            e.company[0]
          )}

      <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-zinc-100 mt-7 mb-3" style={F_DISPLAY}>

      </ul>

  );
}

            key={i}
            onClick={() => c.image && setSelectedCert(c)}
            className={`bg-zinc-900/60 border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col gap-3 transition ${
              c.image ? "cursor-pointer hover:border-pink-500/50 hover:bg-zinc-900" : ""
            }`}
          >
            {c.image ? (
              <div className="relative group overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-zinc-800">
                <img
                  src={c.image}
                  alt={c.title}
                  className="w-full h-40 object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition duration-300"
                />
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/40 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition flex items-center justify-center text-xs text-white" style={F_MONO}>
                  Click to view full certificate
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="w-full h-40 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-700 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-zinc-600">
                <Award size={18} />
                <span className="text-[11px]" style={F_MONO}>Certificate verified</span>
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
              <Award size={15} className="text-pink-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-zinc-200 leading-snug">{c.title}</div>
                {c.issuer && <div className="text-xs text-zinc-500 mt-0.5">{c.issuer}</div>}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Lightbox / Modal */}
      {selectedCert && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4"
          onClick={() => setSelectedCert(null)}
        >
          <div
            className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl max-w-3xl w-full p-4 relative flex flex-col gap-3 shadow-2xl"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-100" style={F_DISPLAY}>{selectedCert.title}</h3>
                {selectedCert.issuer && <div className="text-xs text-zinc-400">{selectedCert.issuer}</div>}
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setSelectedCert(null)}
                className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full border border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-center text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:border-zinc-600 transition"
              >
                <X size={16} />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="max-h-[75vh] overflow-auto rounded-lg border border-zinc-800">
              <img src={selectedCert.image} alt={selectedCert.title} className="w-full h-auto object-contain" />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------------- app ---------------- */
export default function App() {
  useFonts();
  const [view, setView] = useState("home");
  const [activeProject, setActiveProject] = useState(null);

  function go(v) {
    setView(v);
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "instant" });
  }
  function openProject(p) {
    setActiveProject(p);
    go("detail");
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-black text-zinc-100 relative" style={F_BODY}>
      <div
        className="fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none"
        style={{
          background:
            "radial-gradient(ellipse 700px 500px at 15% -5%, rgba(155,107,255,.15), transparent 60%), radial-gradient(ellipse 600px 500px at 100% 10%, rgba(255,95,168,.10), transparent 60%)",
        }}
      />
      <div className="relative z-10">
        <Nav view={view} go={go} />
        <main className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6">
          {view === "home" && <HomePage go={go} openProject={openProject} />}
          {view === "work" && <WorkPage go={go} />}
          {view === "projects" && <ProjectsPage go={go} openProject={openProject} />}
          {view === "detail" && activeProject && <ProjectDetail p={activeProject} go={go} />}
          {view === "resume" && <ResumePage go={go} />}
          {view === "journey" && <JourneyPage go={go} />}
          {view === "education" && <EducationPage go={go} />}
          {view === "certs" && <CertsPage go={go} />}

          <footer className="text-center py-14 mt-6">
            <div className="max-w-md mx-auto border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl p-8 relative overflow-hidden mb-6">
              <div className="text-6xl text-zinc-900 absolute top-1 left-4 select-none" style={F_DISPLAY}>&ldquo;</div>
              <p className="italic text-zinc-400 relative">{TAGLINE}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="text-sm text-zinc-600">
              Design &amp; Developed by <b className="text-zinc-400">Pathan Anjum Azra</b>
              <br />© 2026. All rights reserved.
            </div>
          </footer>
        </main>
      </div>
      <RoamingPet />
    </div>
  );
}
